notes.title: Bug fixes & Known issues
notes.content:
[b]Welcome to the little bugfix.[/b]

[i] Yes, we noticed these issues that crept in during the release,
and we have released a small fix. It is important that we know about some bugs and errors, but we are currently busy, which is why we list everything that has been fixed and what is still pending for the upcoming updates![/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/769ec492c7b86c08ab428c6418859b8028843045.png[/img]

[b]Bugs that have been fixed.[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a collider that causes the player to go out of bounds in forest area.
[*] The cutscenes were optimized to get better performance
[*] Flashlight clipping has been fixed in Floor.
[/list]

[b]Bugs that are still there.[/b]

[list]
[*] the puppets are killswitch to do a gamebreaking bug. (it will get fixed soon or later.)
[*] The curtains can be opened and closed from a further distance
[*] some lights are not adjusted yet. in certain areas.
[/list]

[i]we apologize for the long wait. however, we hope that this will improve your experience with the game![/i]

notes.title: Ultimate update. Fall 2023.
notes.content:
[b]general information for the update[/b]

[i]We listened to their requests and realized that the game wasn't really good enough for us in some places, let alone graphically. which is why we decided to redesign the game and many chapters and make them better. The new version includes balance changes, revised graphics & models, cutscenes, a tutorial, adjusted effects, better lighting effects in general, the animation IK has been sensibly adjusted. and the monsters are now more beginner friendly except in hard mode. The update is planned for fall 2023 but may deviate if we get errors[/i]

[b]A showcase of things that have changed[/b]

[u]Forest[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/0b3a86a1c309272a11b826ac6400c4b927359249.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/8b9314f9bd4197151c970ae74c14b013a0a714ae.png[/img]


[u]Apartment[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/073d59fb5577b21bbc7f1cf4d6754e3a0ff5fc41.png[/img]


[u]Floor[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/96ac2a5d23a1b8de7c0d8dea808ecd497e8c8aa5.png[/img]


[u]Maingame[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/80f042de832bc0099abd4075761e62a31ac24ba2.png[/img]

[u]Basement[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/0fc5778370699f6bed40f074f60005c06fb22159.png[/img]


[b]Information about the maingame[/b]

[i]We have often heard and also noticed it ourselves that the main game was stretched too long in many places and also caused frustration among many, which is why we have also completely changed this area. It is now a hide & seek game with the Kluronic you have to reactivate the PC and download over and over again until the bar on the screen is full. should the kluronic come in, you have to hide in the closet or behind the sofa. and wait for him to leave the room.[/i]

[b]Here is the full spotlight.[/b]

[previewyoutube=wqoVkLSDpoE;full][/previewyoutube]




[i]We hope that we can improve your experience with the update.[/i]


[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/dea5ddeb4708ea26485810f1a07c5e49fcbf750a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41437139/32bf2548bcce6a085181d8a31ea1cbc175870a6c.png[/img][/url]
